sections.h2: Why a single scope beats three separate contractors
body: Picture a typical whole-property request: the siding is chalking, the deck has gone gray, a kitchen wants new cabinet color, and there is a water stain on a ceiling. Hire three trades and you get three schedules and three people pointing at each other when something goes wrong. Our painting services in Trenton FL put all of it on one estimate, worked by one crew, with one warranty covering the result.

That matters more in a small town. Trenton is the Gilchrist County seat, and its downtown, the Hart Springs area, and the Suwannee River corridor are not places where you want trucks coming and going all month. Grouping the work keeps the job tight.

sections.h2: The full menu, beyond walls and trim
body: Painting is the core, but the surfaces under the paint are what usually need help. Alongside interior, exterior, and commercial repaints, we handle:
bullets: Repairs before coating: drywall patching, stucco crack repair, rot and fascia replacement, re-caulking
Wood care: deck and fence staining with penetrating stains, plus wood finishing
Cleaning: pressure washing and soft washing for siding, drives, and decks
Specialty work: cabinet refinishing, popcorn ceiling removal, concrete and masonry painting, garage floor epoxy and polyaspartic coatings, limewash and other decorative finishes

sections.h2: Phasing a larger job around the seasons
body: Because every estimate is itemized, you can decide what happens now and what waits. A common plan is to wash and paint the exterior during the drier October-through-May window, then do interiors or cabinets in summer, when indoor work is unaffected by afternoon storms. The line items stay the same; only the calendar changes.

Timing per piece is predictable: one interior room is usually a day, a whole-home interior runs three days to two weeks, and a full exterior takes three to seven working days plus washing and dry time.

sections.h2: What every Trenton estimate spells out
body: Each written quote names the surfaces included and excluded, the prep steps, the primer and topcoat products by line, how many coats, and the schedule. Two coats is our baseline, with a third for dramatic color changes or porous surfaces. Browse the full list of painting services, or go back to our main Trenton painter page for local background.

faqs.q: Can I get one estimate that covers inside, outside, and the deck?
faqs.a: Yes. The crew lead walks everything in one visit and itemizes each area separately, so you can approve the whole scope or only part of it.

faqs.q: Do you handle repairs, or only paint?
faqs.a: We do the repairs that a lasting finish depends on, including drywall patching, stucco repair, rotted trim and fascia replacement, and re-caulking. They are listed on the estimate as their own line items.

faqs.q: Will the job be handed off to a subcontractor?
faqs.a: No. Our own crews do the work in Trenton, and the crew lead who priced the job stays involved through the final punch walk.

faqs.q: Do you publish prices for Trenton jobs?
faqs.a: No. Cost depends on measured area, surface condition, product line, access and height, and the number of colors, so we price each property after a free walkthrough.
